detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the CamelBak Rim Runner 22 Hydration Backpack measures 730g. Equipped with 2.5L Crux reservoir with QuickLink system for high-flow hydration on long ascents. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Crux reservoir delivered 20% more water per sip than standard competitor bite valves.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits beginners, long distance, easy setup, heavy load, winter snow. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for minimalist load-hauling.

faqs.question: Is the CamelBak 22 Hydration Backpack true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly.

faqs.question: How does it handle sustained bad weather?
faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the Recycled 200D Ripstop Nylon with C0 DWR showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.
